name: codex-chatgpt-review-loop
description: Bridge-backed ChatGPT review loop for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run a bounded code-review loop through Web LLM Bridge.
interface.longDescription: Coordinates SessionStart and Stop hooks with the Web LLM Bridge review driver. Hooks only prepare context and decide whether another review turn is needed; transport stays in Web LLM Bridge and repo-scoped review state stays below Git metadata.
defaultPrompt: Run the ChatGPT review loop through Web LLM Bridge.
